title: Pin --hostname github.com on the peer reads: fetchReceipt and readPeerVersion
description: fetchReceipt (scripts/qualification/e2e-receipt.mjs) calls `gh api repos/opum-ai/opum-cli-e2e/contents/...` without `--hostname github.com`, so a GH_HOST in the environment could redirect the receipt read that gates promote-release.mjs (pass 1 and the QCLI-388 pair receipt). The tag-peel reads in pair-receipt.mjs already pin it, and lore-cli pins it on its own receipt fetch. lore-cli reported the gap while confirming QCLI-388 AC4 on 2026-09-27. It does not change the verdict logic.

acceptanceCriteria.text: fetchReceipt (e2e-receipt.mjs) and readPeerVersion (version-parity.mjs) both pass --hostname github.com to gh api, and tests assert each argv carries it
With GH_HOST set to a non-github.com host, both reads still target github.com

plan: Add exported peerReadArgs(peer) to version-parity.mjs plus its .d.mts and use it in readPeerVersion; add --hostname github.com to the gh argv in fetchReceipt (e2e-receipt.mjs).
Pin each argv in tests (host, media type, repo, path, ref) and assert a foreign GH_HOST does not change it: test/qcli386-version-parity.test.ts and test/e2e/release/e2e-receipt.test.ts.
Run bun run check with the pinned bun 1.4.2.

Tracker-only commit: file one follow-up task for the two QCLI-305 record-note corrections (the note claiming 7 tests when the file has 8, and the real-run evidence head 164d3565 predating the final code head 8d98cb3b).
Push, open the PR, verify both acceptance criteria, and dispatch review-assignment against the exact SHA before landing via opum-control.
implementationNotes: Extended 2026-09-27: lore-cli found the same gap in scripts/qualification/version-parity.mjs readPeerVersion, checked here. Lore's mirror exports peerReadArgs() with --hostname so a test can pin the argv, and that shape is worth copying.
